description: Unit test class for CalendarEventConflictResolver, testing conflict resolution logic in calendar event synchronization.

classes.name: CalendarEventConflictResolverTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for validating conflict resolution in CalendarEventConflictResolver.

methods.name: testUnrelatedEventsSkipValidationInProductionMode
methods.description: Tests that unrelated events do not cause errors in production mode.

methods.name: testYear2038TimestampWarning
methods.description: Checks for warnings when events have timestamps beyond year 2038.

methods.name: testXSSPatternDetection
methods.description: Validates detection of XSS patterns in event titles.

methods.name: testSubSecondPrecisionDetection
methods.description: Verifies detection of modifications within sub-second resolution.

methods.name: testClockSkewTolerance
methods.description: Ensures clock skew tolerance prevents false conflict detection.

methods.name: testTimestampTieBreaker
methods.description: Checks that timestamp tie-breaker correctly determines winner when timestamps are equal.

methods.name: testContentComparisonUsesChecksum
methods.description: Confirms checksum is used for content comparison performance.

methods.name: testDeprecatedResolveConflictMethod
methods.description: Validates that deprecated methods still function.

methods.description: Tests scenario where only the target event was modified.

methods.description: Tests scenario where only the source event was modified.

methods.name: testBothModifiedToIdenticalContent

methods.description: Checks that external wins in external-based conflict resolution.

methods.name: testTwoSidedConflictInternalBasedStrategyInternalWins
methods.description: Checks internal wins in internal-based conflict resolution.
